resources.string: LiMo will note which app is in front, by its name only, to count screen time and to cover apps a parent blocked. It never reads what is on the screen. In this early build it does nothing yet.
LiMo will stop itself from being removed without a parent. It asks for no other powers: it cannot wipe the phone, change the screen lock or use the camera. In this early build it does nothing yet.
